evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that Qwen1.5-1.8B achieves scores of 46.8 on MMLU, 59.7 on C-Eval, 38.4 on GSM8K, 10.1 on MATH, 20.1 on HumanEval, 18.0 on MBPP, 24.2 on BBH, and 57.8 on CMMLU. Additional reported results include 33.57 on Exams, 48.37 on Understanding, 6.47 on Math, and 16.19 on Translation.
